scope: Original I-IV formal simulation inputs; source files read only.

schema_interpretation.G: Independent standard Gaussian base design before scaling/spikes.
schema_interpretation.scale_z: Independent standard Gaussian log-column-scale seed; arm-specific heterogeneity is applied before the 98th-percentile cap and RMS normalization.
schema_interpretation.beta0: I: already unit-normalized true coefficient. IV: final true coefficient, normalized by direction-specific model.
schema_interpretation.beta_direction: Unnormalized independent Gaussian coefficient direction; normalize only when constructing the realized design/response.
schema_interpretation.standard_noise: Independent standard Gaussian response noise; multiply by the arm sigma when constructing y.
schema_interpretation.spike_noise: Independent standard Gaussian design perturbations; only spike_mask rows receive the arm-specific multiplier.
schema_interpretation.spike_mask: II/III row and IV row: exactly 36 selected rows among 1200. IV column: 1200 false entries, retained as a common diagnostic schema.
schema_interpretation.X: IV final normalized design: 60 by 1200 for column, 1200 by 60 for row.
schema_interpretation.y: IV final response X beta0 + 0.5 standard Gaussian noise; replace by all zeros only for zero_response.
schema_interpretation.covariance: IV diagonal conditional future-design covariance: scales squared / 60 for column; constant training_scale squared times (0.25 squared + 0.03 times 8 squared) for row.

protocol_symbols.budget: with-replacement draw count; written N in current paper
protocol_symbols.objects: 1200 selectable columns for column schemes, 1200 selectable rows for row schemes
protocol_symbols.dimension: 60-dimensional native state space in the formal protocols

runtime_interface_boundary: The existing formal runners still generate fresh output inputs from frozen seeds; no --inputs option is introduced.
Published original inputs can be read directly with numpy.load(path, allow_pickle=False).
Do not point ordinary analyze at the simulations directory: it contains compressed metric tables and original inputs, not the expected saved-state tree.
Full native_states, raw sampled states, counts, targets and influences are derived computational archives, not additional simulation input datasets.
I/II sensitivity arms reuse base files 01-06 and zero_response reuses 01-02. III c/zero arms reuse each direction 01-02. IV tail/zero arms reuse each direction 01.
Preserve original NPZ bytes and SHA values. Recreating from seeds need not preserve all normalized floating-point bits or the compressed-file bytes.
